g.text: Near-zero-downtime cutover (<10m write-fence) — 5-stage T-minus & pre-PONR U-turn
Chronological T-minus ruler drives left-to-right cutover · Rollback track terminates BEFORE Stage 5 (Dual-Signed PONR)
Zero-data-loss cutover state machine · Pre-armed reverse-CDC safety window
Forward cutover progression (left -> right across T-minus milestones)
User Flow: Flip -> 30m Soak -> PONR & Abort (U1–U3)
Data Flow: Freeze -> LSN=0 -> Rev-CDC Drain (D1–D3)
